claimReviews.question: Caloric allowance is a separate unimplemented decision
claimReviews.finding: Energy expenditure is not an individualized dietary allowance. A proposed allowance needs a defined outcome, horizon and appropriate evaluation.
claimReviews.permittedInterpretation: Keep allowance unimplemented; no automatic deficit or target from an energy estimate.
claimReviews.reviewScope: Bounded source relevance and method distinction only; clinical severity, treatments and intersections remain unreviewed.
claimReviews.reversalTrigger: New contrary evidence, changed methods/rights or consequential reuse; reopen the named downstream evaluation.

claimReviews.question: Proposed calibration, provenance ledger, Bayesian modeling and allowance architecture remain unimplemented.
claimReviews.finding: Weight trends, logged intake and expenditure are jointly ambiguous when intake error and fluid shifts are unknown. Bayesian structure does not remove missing information.
claimReviews.permittedInterpretation: Keep calibration unimplemented pending forward-time comparison against a fixed baseline and independent reference.
